svg.title: Plastic laminate partition door, edge view
svg.desc: A plastic laminate door cut through near its edge: a resin-impregnated particleboard core with high-pressure laminate bonded to both faces, and a thin laminate layer covering the edge so the core is sealed all round. 1 inch thick.
svg.text: Edge view: a door cut through near its edge. Faces and edge not to scale.
